intent: Generate the telemetry-ingestion-processing project root and build scaffold using the mcp-server-springboot skill, rooted at /home/caupolican/Desktop/Blackboard/blackboard_evaluator_project/projects/high-performance-time-series-telemetry-ingestion-pipeline/services/telemetry-ingestion-processing/, with language version Java 21, framework version Spring Boot 3, base package com.blackboard.telemetry, and build dependencies webflux, data-r2dbc, flyway, actuator, h2, test, reactor-test (covering every starter and test artifact; the pom must carry spring-boot-starter-test and reactor-test, plus r2dbc-h2 and a JDBC H2 driver as the embeddable in-process substitute).
